claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nelfinavir at 2.5 µM is unlikely to kill most cancer cell lines; its annotated HIV protease inhibition is irrelevant to human cells, and any observed killing would likely reflect nonspecific effects such as P-glycoprotein inhibition or lysosomal stress rather than a targeted cytotoxic mechanism.
